h1: SalonGo features: online booking, checkout, EET 2.0, payroll
lead: Bookings, checkout with EET, income and expenses, clients and staff pay in one app. On phone, iPad and computer.

booking.title: Online booking page for your salon
booking.lead: Your salon gets its own booking link for Facebook, Instagram and Google Maps. Clients pick a service, a staff member and a free time, with no app to install.
points: Clients book in Czech, Slovak, German, English or French
New bookings arrive on your phone; confirm and assign staff in one box
Confirmation email and a reminder 1 hour before
booking.alt: Confirming online bookings and assigning staff in SalonGo on a computer
booking.altPhone: The salon's online booking page on a client's phone, choosing a time

calendar.title: Appointment calendar per staff member
calendar.lead: One column per staff member, so you see at a glance who is free. Bookings without a chosen person go to whoever is free and least busy.
points: View by staff member or as a list
Every booking takes the service's real duration
The booking page only shows free times, so no double bookings
calendar.alt: A day of appointments per staff member in SalonGo

checkout.title: Salon checkout with Czech EET 2.0
checkout.lead: Pick the service, the staff member and how the client pays, and the receipt is done. Turn on EET once, then every receipt is sent to the tax office by itself.
points: Cash, card or bank transfer by QR code with the amount filled in
Tips recorded separately for staff
80 mm receipts with the FIK code
EET 2.0 is mandatory from 1 Jan 2027 and included in every plan
checkout.alt: SalonGo checkout: services, staff member and payment method

thuchi.title: Salon income and expenses
thuchi.lead: The income tab adds up your receipts by itself. The expenses tab records stock, rent and the like: amount, date, payment method and a short note.
points: Income minus expenses at a glance, per location
Export to CSV, Excel or PDF for your accountant
thuchi.alt: Income and expenses in SalonGo: income from receipts and salon expenses

customers.title: Client records and regulars
customers.lead: Every client has their service history, number of visits and total spend. Regulars are recognised straight away.
points: Filter VIP, new and lapsed clients
VIP status set automatically by your own rule
Birthday reminder 2 days ahead
customers.alt: Client list in SalonGo with visits and spend

marketing.title: Offer emails for regular clients
marketing.lead: Pick a template for Women's Day, Christmas or a birthday, add a discount and send. Only clients who agreed to offers receive it.
points: 10 templates, written in 6 languages, all editable
Preview and send a test to yourself
Sent in your salon's name, with a one-tap unsubscribe link
marketing.alt: Women's Day offer email in SalonGo on a phone
marketing.alt2: Client birthday reminder in SalonGo on a phone

payroll.title: Automatic staff payroll
payroll.lead: Each staff member has one pay type: a percentage of revenue or a fixed salary. Tips go to whoever was tipped or are split equally, your choice.
points: A different percentage per service if you need it
Payroll per period: pay, revenue, tips, number of receipts
Export to Excel, CSV or PDF
payroll.alt: Staff payroll for a period in SalonGo

staff.title: Staff app: their own schedule and revenue
staff.lead: Every staff member has their own login on the phone, with notifications in their own language. You decide what they see.
points: Invite by email; they set a password and start
Schedule only, or schedule plus their own revenue
Staff never see the whole salon's revenue
staff.cap1: A staff member's schedule for today
staff.cap2: The owner chooses what staff can see

branches.title: Manage multiple salon locations in one account
branches.lead: Add a location right in the app. Switch with one tap and see revenue and bookings for all locations on one page.
points: Each location has its own calendar, staff, services and receipts
New locations get a {days}-day trial
Each location has its own plan and renewal
branches.alt: The All salons page in SalonGo: revenue and bookings per location

services.title: Services and price list
services.text: Colour-coded categories, durations and prices. Show or hide each service on the booking page.

reports.title: Revenue reports and receipts
reports.text: Revenue by day, staff member, service and payment method. Find, reprint or export receipts to PDF.

devices.title: Phone, iPad, Mac, Windows and browser
devices.text: One account on every device, always the same data. The app speaks 6 languages: Vietnamese, Czech, Slovak, English, German, French.

desk.title: Chair plan for renters
desk.text: Your own IČO? Checkout, receipts and EET in your name for {priceDesk} CZK a month.

closing.title: Try every feature free for {days} days
closing.lead: No card needed. Every plan has every feature; they differ only by staff and locations.
